title: Stock art-direction vocabulary v2

metadata.purpose: A team-agnostic stock vocabulary for directing game art: naming what to look at, what may be manipulated, and under which conditions a number means anything.
metadata.scope: Domain vocabulary for visual production, 2D and 3D alike: perception, composition, form, space, camera, value, light, colour, material, geometry, UV and texture, vector, sprite and pixel, motion, rig and animation, VFX, shader, render, cost and QC, and pipeline. A given tool will reach only part of it; the vocabulary is deliberately wider than any one tool unit.
metadata.derivation: Mechanically derived from ad_ta_vocab v1 by tools/trim_vocab.py. Each entry records origin.entry_sha256 over its v1 source entry.
not_included: The learning layer: the practice exercises of the methods category, and curriculum_weeks. Entries under methods that are production review rather than practice are kept, each carrying a scope_note saying why
The v1 source documents, quotes and evidence spans, which stay in the origin corpus because they are Korean education-context interviews rather than domain vocabulary
Executable tool commands or runtime bindings
metadata.language_policy: English is canonical. Head-term text for other languages lives in locales/<code>.json. aliases[] carries every spelling inline, tagged by language, so a comment written in any of them can be matched without loading a locale file.
metadata.translation_status: Descriptions and guidance are editorial English, marked translated_by: llm. The 70 judgment terms and 155 manipulation terms carry translation_review: needed until a human confirms them.

unit_registry.unitless: A dimensionless number. A 0-1 range applies only when the property model guarantees it.
unit_registry.ratio: A ratio whose numerator and denominator are stated.
unit_registry.factor: A multiplier applied to a reference value. 1.2 is a 20% relative increase.
unit_registry.percent_relative: Rate of change against a reference value. +20 means baseline x 1.20.
unit_registry.percentage_point: Absolute change of a 0-1 ratio value. +10 means baseline + 0.10.
unit_registry.percent_of_reference: What percentage of a stated denominator something is. Not a rate of change.
unit_registry.px: A pixel of a named image or render-target grid. Distinguishing internal from final output is mandatory.
unit_registry.px2: Pixel area on a named image grid.
unit_registry.texel: The sample unit of a named texture grid.
unit_registry.m: Meter. State the correspondence to scene units.
unit_registry.cm: Centimeter. State the correspondence to scene units.
unit_registry.mm: Millimeter. State the correspondence to scene units.
unit_registry.scene_unit: The spatial unit defined for that scene.
unit_registry.svg_user_unit: A coordinate unit inside a named SVG viewBox.
unit_registry.normalized_coordinate: A normalized coordinate within a stated reference region. Origin and axis direction are mandatory.
unit_registry.normalized_area: A proportion of a stated reference area.
unit_registry.uv_unit: A coordinate unit of that UV channel. Not necessarily clamped to 0-1.
unit_registry.deg: Degree. State the reference axis, coordinate system and rotation order.
unit_registry.rad: Radian. State the reference axis, coordinate system and rotation order.
unit_registry.s: Second. State the time origin and the target timeline.
unit_registry.ms: Millisecond. State whether it is elapsed time or a measured cost, and its range.
unit_registry.frame: A frame under a stated frame rate and time base.
unit_registry.fps: Frames or drawn samples per second. Distinguish render, clip, display and simulation.
unit_registry.Hz: Cycles or samples per second. State which phenomenon the frequency belongs to.
unit_registry.count: A non-negative integer count. State what is actually being counted.
unit_registry.index: An integer index. State the valid range and the table it indexes.
unit_registry.byte: Memory in bytes. State the target, such as CPU, GPU or disk.
unit_registry.K: Kelvin, where the light model defines it. Different from an arbitrary Temperature slider.
unit_registry.EV: Where the tool defines exposure difference in stops. Confirm the correspondence to the linear factor 2^dEV in that model.
unit_registry.texel_per_scene_unit: Texels per one stated unit of scene length.
unit_registry.overdraw_count: How many times pixel processing is repeated, under a stated tool and scope.
unit_registry.declared_tool_unit: A tool unit defined by an official model or a runtime adapter. The unit name alone is not sufficient.
unit_registry.pixel_per_scene_unit: Source sprite pixel count divided by a scene length unit.

proxy.note: The concept itself has no common numeric knob. Any number is a separately defined proxy and cannot claim to have measured the whole concept.

qualitative.note: Vocabulary used for description and judgment, not a numeric parameter.

undefined.note: The working definition in this file is an editorial proposal and is not declared a standard definition.

relation.note: Specified as a relation between targets. Expressing it as a percentage requires a separate scale.

area.note: Distinguish a length factor from an area factor.

image_shape.note: A whole shape is not a scalar. Set the measured quantity separately, such as width, area or contour difference.

pixel_length.note: Internal render px and final output px are different grids.

ratio.note: State the numerator, the denominator and the basis of the change.

length.note: Manipulate only when unit and coordinate system agree.

position.note: Fix local, world or screen space and the reference state.

angle.note: State the meaning of the angle separately, such as the FOV axis or the Euler order.

factor.note: Compute from a fixed baseline so repeated execution does not accumulate.

distance.note: State the two reference points of the distance and the space it is measured in.

matrix.note: Fix the matrix dimensions and the row/column and multiplication conventions.

coordinate_system.note: A space name alone is not sufficient. A concrete coordinate convention is required.

enum.note: Confirm the options against the actual tool and version.

structure.note: State the graph, hierarchy or composition and which structure must be preserved.

sequence.note: Render order can be expressed as a precedence relation instead of a time value.

color.note: A model such as RGB or HSV and the color-handling conditions are mandatory.

color_set.note: The number of colors alone does not determine the color relationships.

hue.note: Hue is a cyclic quantity. An angular offset under a stated model can be clearer than a rate of change.

color_scalar.note: The definition of saturation or vibrance differs between tools.

color_space.note: Linear alone does not also specify the RGB gamut.

material_scalar.note: Verify correspondences such as roughness and smoothness per model.

unitless01.note: A 0-1 range applies only when it is a normalized parameter of the chosen model.

signed_unitless.note: The -1 to 1 range of N dot L holds only when both inputs are unit vectors.

scalar.note: Fix the model and the range.

light_intensity.note: Do not auto-convert between physical units and an engine arbitrary unit.

emission.note: Separate the emissive input, bloom, and actual lighting contribution to surroundings.

temperature.note: Distinguish Kelvin from a creative Temperature slider.

exposure.note: If the tool defines exposure difference in stops, the linear factor is 2^dEV. This differs from plain RGB addition.

transfer_curve.note: Specify the actual operation and the stage at which gamma or tone mapping is applied.

count.note: Fix what is counted at which evaluation stage, and use integers.

image_size.note: 200px alone is ambiguous between width, height and long edge.

asset_ref.note: Do not infer content, revision or access rights from a file name alone.

texel_density.note: Distinguish length density from area density.

direction_vector.note: Distinguish the transform of a direction vector from that of a position vector.

topology.note: Connectivity cannot be checked from vertex coordinates alone.

duration.note: 8 frames @ 12fps and 8 frames @ 60fps are different durations.

frequency.note: Keep the time bases of display, simulation, pose and clip separate.

curve.note: Distinguish the curve itself from total duration and spatial path.

trajectory.note: Separate the positional path from the distribution over time.

overdraw.note: A metric dependent on the tool and the measurement definition.

memory.note: Do not equate on-disk file size with GPU resident size.

cost_time.note: Fix the profiling conditions and the statistic, such as median or percentile.

string.note: Distinguish a stable identifier from a human-readable name.

rectangle.note: Fix the coordinate space and the definition of the rectangle.

pixels_per_unit.note: State the correspondence between the source sprite grid and the scene unit.

numeric_rules.rule_en: Reducing by 20% means 0.8x the reference value. On a 0-1 ratio, reducing by 20 percentage points means -0.20. Repeated requests reference a fixed baseline to prevent accumulation.

For uniform 2D scaling in one plane with aspect ratio preserved, a length factor k gives an area factor k^2. A 20% area increase is a length factor of sqrt(1.2). Where projection or occlusion changes, re-measure from the screen mask.
px is interpretable only with an image_ref and a resolution. Source texel, internal render px and final output px are never substituted for one another.
Position, size and angle state the target, space, axis, origin and parent transform. For FOV, distinguish vertical, horizontal and diagonal.
Color, saturation, gamma and roughness values are bound to a color model, shader model, encoding and parameter range. Do not copy a value between tools on the strength of a matching name.
A frame count converts to time only with timebase.fps and a clock. Keep 12fps authoring, 60fps display and physics update in separate fields.
Goals such as readability, affordance and sense of weight require a metric or a human rubric before any numeric operation. Mask width and contrast are proxies, not proof of the whole goal.
Numbers in examples are values for illustrating serialization, not recommended or industry-standard thresholds for any game genre or platform.
This JSON is dictionary and request data. An actual change is executed only at a runtime where target, tool version, property binding, permitted write scope and authorization are all resolved.

ambiguous_tokens.resolution_note: Spatial mask overlap and temporal overlap of part motion are different meanings.
Distinguish a painted boundary, a shading boundary and geometric connectivity.
Distinguish the surface tangent frame from tangent handle control on a curve.
Linear-light color and interpolation over time are unrelated.
Distinguish artistic value from an output-side operation.
Artistic value, a color-model value and a material input are never substituted for one another.
Even under the same unit name the model and encoding may differ. Do not convert one to the other by reciprocal.
Do not assume the data origin and the current operation pivot are the same point.
Distinguish distance in space from an encoded buffer value.
Texture compression and animation compression are different data transforms.
In this extraction, extrusion is the padding context. Do not generalize it to a general mesh extrude command.
Distinguish a material signal, image post-processing, and lighting another target.
Sculptural mass, perceived weight and physical center of mass are different concepts.
FOV, dolly movement and orthographic extent are not the same manipulation.
Distinguish light Kelvin, relational warm/cool, and a tool color-correction control.
State the time base of render, simulation, clip and drawn samples.
Distinguish the local sense of an operation layer from the surface of an object.
Distinguish screen contour, perceived volume, and actual spatial geometry.
A 20% length increase is not the same as a 20% area increase.

entries.label: visual hierarchy

aliases.text: ビジュアルヒエラルキー
ลำดับความสำคัญทางสายตา

entries.description: The importance relation that makes some screen elements read before others.

operationalization.guidance: Adjust differences in size, value, color and motion per target, and confirm the actual reading order.

entries.label: readability

aliases.text: ความอ่านง่าย

entries.description: How far the meaning of a subject or action separates within the required size and viewing time.

operationalization.guidance: Fix the target under test, the display size, the background and the exposure time, then define a discrimination task.

entries.label: silhouette readability

aliases.text: ความอ่านง่ายของซิลูเอตต์

entries.description: How far a subject or pose reads from the outer mass alone, without interior detail.

operationalization.guidance: Compare masks with material and interior lines hidden, from a fixed camera.

entries.label: icon readability

aliases.text: ความอ่านง่ายของไอคอน

entries.description: How far the type and function of a symbol stay distinguishable at small display size.

operationalization.guidance: Inspect the outline, the gaps and the value grouping at the intended display size.

entries.label: scale readability

aliases.text: ความอ่านง่ายเมื่อเปลี่ยนขนาด

entries.description: How far the key features hold up under scaling or a change of viewing distance.

operationalization.guidance: Compare the same asset at several stated resolutions or screen occupancies.

entries.label: material readability

aliases.text: ความอ่านง่ายของวัสดุ

entries.description: How far the intended material separates from surface cues alone.

operationalization.guidance: Compare highlight, roughness and color cues under identical lighting and camera.

entries.label: affordance

aliases.text: แอฟฟอร์แดนซ์
การบอกใบ้การกระทำ

entries.description: The term for what a game screen lets you do and how that possibility is conveyed.

operationalization.guidance: State the actions that are genuinely possible and the visual cues that announce them separately. Being conspicuous does not by itself establish that an action is possible.

entries.label: figure-ground

aliases.text: フィギュア・グラウンド
ภาพกับพื้น

entries.description: The relation by which a viewer separates which area is subject and which is ground.

operationalization.guidance: Vary boundary, value, overlap and shading, but evaluate by the reading outcome for the stated target.

entries.label: attention
entries.description: The phenomenon of a viewer putting processing resources on part of the screen.

operationalization.guidance: Name the intended object of attention and the distractors, then confirm by observation or task.

entries.label: visual saliency

aliases.text: ความเด่นทางสายตา

entries.description: The property of standing out because of difference from the surroundings.

operationalization.guidance: Adjust candidates among contrast, area and motion. Do not equate a computed saliency score with actual attention.

entries.label: preattentive processing

aliases.text: การประมวลผลก่อนการเพ่งมอง

entries.description: The concept covering visual features that separate before conscious detailed search.

operationalization.guidance: Decide which categories are to be separated by color or shape, then confirm with a visual search task.

entries.label: Gestalt principles

aliases.text: หลักเกสตัลท์

entries.description: The set of principles covering how parts tend to organize into one group or figure.

operationalization.guidance: State which elements are to be read as one group. Do not add detailed laws that are absent from the source at will.

entries.label: perceptual grouping

aliases.text: การจัดกลุ่มทางการรับรู้

entries.description: The relation by which several elements read as a single bundle.

operationalization.guidance: Adjust shared and differing spacing, color, shape and motion, then confirm the group boundaries.

entries.label: depth perception

aliases.text: การรับรู้ความลึก

entries.description: Reading front-to-back distance and solid relations from a flat image.

operationalization.guidance: Adjust overlap, perspective and value cues, then test the reading of front-to-back order.

entries.label: visual cognition

aliases.text: การรู้คิดทางสายตา

entries.description: The process of interpreting visual input as objects, relations and meaning.

operationalization.guidance: State a concrete interpretation task. Do not assume a single visual-cognition slider.

entries.label: contextual perception

aliases.text: การรับรู้ตามบริบท

entries.description: The property that the same subject reads differently with surroundings and situation.

operationalization.guidance: Hold the target fixed and compare by changing the background or neighboring elements.

entries.label: semiotics
entries.description: The relation by which shape, color and marking carry a specific meaning.

operationalization.guidance: Record the in-game meaning the sign points to and the interpretation expected of the viewer.

entries.label: style coherence

aliases.text: ความสอดคล้องของสไตล์

entries.description: How far assets and effects look consistent with the shared visual rules.

operationalization.guidance: Compare silhouette, palette, edge, material and timing rules against a reference asset.

entries.label: gameplay clarity

aliases.text: ゲームプレイの明瞭性
ความชัดเจนของเกมเพลย์

entries.description: How far the objects, events and actions needed for play are conveyed visually.

operationalization.guidance: Separately from decorative polish, test the reading of enemy, hazard, contact and activation timing.

entries.label: visual clutter

aliases.text: ความรกทางสายตา

entries.description: The state where competing elements bury the information that is needed.

operationalization.guidance: Reduce unnecessary contrast, detail and effects, and confirm that the required information survives.

entries.label: visual weight

aliases.text: น้ำหนักทางสายตา

entries.description: The relative heaviness produced by size, position, color and contrast.

operationalization.guidance: Keep this separate from actual mass and name, as a comparison pair, which element should feel heavier.

entries.label: visual intent

aliases.text: ビジュアルインテント
เจตนาทางภาพ

entries.description: The role, emotion or information you mean to convey on screen through manipulation.

operationalization.guidance: Record the outcome that must be preserved and who judges it, before any implementation parameter.

entries.label: spectacle

aliases.text: ความตระการตา

entries.description: An expressive goal of catching the eye with scale, stimulus or strong change.

operationalization.guidance: Test brightness, scale, frequency and afterimage within the range that preserves gameplay reading.

entries.label: composition

aliases.text: องค์ประกอบภาพ

entries.description: The organized relation of elements and empty space inside the frame.

operationalization.guidance: Design target placement, size, overlap and value masses together, but state which variables change.

entries.label: balance
entries.description: How far the visual weight of the frame sits stable or leans on purpose.

operationalization.guidance: Compare the distribution of shape placement and contrast. Do not equate the numeric centroid with perceptual balance.

entries.label: focal point

aliases.text: จุดสนใจหลัก

entries.description: The point or subject meant to read first in the frame.

operationalization.guidance: Specify the target selector and its priority, and manage the surrounding contrast.

entries.label: staging
entries.description: Placing figures, props and camera so the action and relations read clearly.

operationalization.guidance: Review pose, distance, overlap and screen direction together.

entries.label: framing

aliases.text: การจัดเฟรม

entries.description: Deciding what the camera frame includes and what it leaves out.

operationalization.guidance: Specify the frame boundary and the target's occupancy.

entries.label: positive space

aliases.text: พื้นที่บวก

entries.description: The screen area the subject's shape occupies.

operationalization.guidance: Fix the target mask, camera and resolution, then treat it as area or occupancy.

entries.label: negative space

aliases.text: พื้นที่ว่าง

entries.description: The area that reads as empty around or between subjects.

operationalization.guidance: Specify which gap between which targets, and inspect its width, area and connectivity.

entries.label: overlap

aliases.text: การซ้อนทับ

entries.description: The relation where two subjects' areas cover each other in screen projection.

operationalization.guidance: Fix the target pair and the camera, then compare overlapping mask area. Distinguish this from temporal overlap.

confusable_with.note: Spatial mask overlap and temporal overlap of part motion are different meanings.

entries.label: foreground
entries.description: The screen layer that reads as nearest to the viewpoint.

operationalization.guidance: Specify the set of targets that must read as foreground and their depth and contrast relations.

entries.label: midground
entries.description: The layer between foreground and background that ties action or space together.

operationalization.guidance: Adjust the midground targets and their separation from the layers in front and behind.

entries.label: background
entries.description: The screen layer that surrounds or reads behind the main subject.

operationalization.guidance: State whether it must stay lower in priority than the main targets.

entries.label: line

aliases.text: ทิศทางของเส้น

entries.description: The directionality that borders and placement create in the frame.

operationalization.guidance: Do not equate a line with an actual mesh edge; direct the screen angle and convergence relations.

entries.label: rhythm
entries.description: The pattern made by repetition, spacing and accent of elements or events.

operationalization.guidance: Distinguish spatial interval from temporal interval, and set the repeating unit and the order of variation.

entries.label: affinity

aliases.text: ความคล้ายคลึง

entries.description: The relation where color, value, shape or motion are organized to resemble each other.

operationalization.guidance: State which dimension's differences are to be reduced. It does not mean the whole screen must be uniformly similar.

entries.label: contrast
entries.description: The relation where two elements or groups separate because their visual traits differ.

operationalization.guidance: Choose the axis to compare among value, color, shape and motion, and the counterpart target.

entries.label: visual progression

aliases.text: การไล่ระดับทางภาพ

entries.description: A structure in which visual traits change by stages over time or across scenes.

operationalization.guidance: Specify on a timeline the property that changes and the relative intensity of each segment.

entries.label: visual component

aliases.text: องค์ประกอบทางสายตา

entries.description: The view that analyzes a frame as space, line, shape, value, color, motion and rhythm.

operationalization.guidance: Use it as an analytic tag; do not merge different axes into one parameter.

entries.label: screen direction

aliases.text: スクリーンディレクション
ทิศทางในเฟรม

entries.description: The direction an object faces or moves within the frame.

operationalization.guidance: State screen left/right and up/down and the camera, then check the directional relation across cuts.

entries.label: screen occupancy

aliases.text: สัดส่วนพื้นที่ในเฟรม

entries.description: How much of the frame a subject takes up.

operationalization.guidance: Specify whether it is bounding-box area or actual mask area, and the frame that is the denominator.

confusable_with.note: A 20% length increase is not the same as a 20% area increase.

entries.label: reveal

aliases.text: การเผยข้อมูล

entries.description: Staging that exposes hidden or unknown information in the intended order.

operationalization.guidance: Specify what is revealed, when, and through which change of occlusion, camera or lighting.

entries.label: visual continuity

aliases.text: ความต่อเนื่องทางภาพ

entries.description: How far space, action and visual relations still read as connected across cuts or state changes.

operationalization.guidance: State the relations to be preserved, such as position, screen direction and motion phase.

entries.label: tension/release

aliases.text: ความตึงและการคลาย

entries.description: Staging that organizes pressure and relief of events over time.

operationalization.guidance: Specify candidates such as density, contrast, speed and pause, and review the emotional judgment separately.

entries.label: storytelling

aliases.text: การเล่าเรื่องด้วยภาพ

entries.description: The goal of conveying events and relations through shape, placement and change over time.

operationalization.guidance: State who is doing what, and which information is delivered first.

entries.label: storyboard

aliases.text: สตอรีบอร์ด

entries.description: A sequence of drawings that pre-states the events as key frames.

operationalization.guidance: Record per cut the camera, target, action and timing, and the screen direction to preserve.

entries.label: previs
entries.description: Pre-visualization that runs the boards and staging with simple stand-in assets.

operationalization.guidance: Limit the scope to verifying camera, placement and timing rather than final materials.

entries.label: localization-safe composition

aliases.text: ローカライズ耐性のある構図
องค์ประกอบภาพที่รองรับการแปล

entries.description: A layout that keeps function and hierarchy when language and displayed content change.

operationalization.guidance: Decide which text and icon regions will change and which space is held, then test with the actual variants.

entries.label: shape
entries.description: The form that reads as area and outline on a screen or plane.

operationalization.guidance: Manipulate contour, area and proportion, distinct from three-dimensional form.

confusable_with.note: Distinguish screen contour, perceived volume, and actual spatial geometry.
Distinguish screen contour, perceived volume, and actual spatial geometry.

entries.label: form
entries.description: An object form understood as having volume and facing planes.

operationalization.guidance: Compose it as basic volumes and plane transitions, and confirm from several viewpoints.

confusable_with.note: Distinguish screen contour, perceived volume, and actual spatial geometry.
Distinguish screen contour, perceived volume, and actual spatial geometry.

entries.label: silhouette

aliases.text: เงาโครงร่าง

entries.description: The projected outline and mass left when interior detail is removed.

operationalization.guidance: Inspect as a mask at a specified camera, pose and resolution.

entries.label: contour
entries.description: The outer boundary of a form, or the line that states it.

operationalization.guidance: Specify which contour segment changes, and keep it separate from interior panel lines.

entries.label: outer contour

aliases.text: เส้นขอบนอก

entries.description: The outer boundary that divides object from background.

operationalization.guidance: Prioritize the features that must survive at small display sizes.

entries.label: edge control

aliases.text: การควบคุมขอบ

entries.description: Controlling whether boundaries read sharp, soft, continuous or lost.

operationalization.guidance: Adjust the width and contrast of the screen-side edge. Do not confuse this with a mesh hard-edge setting.

confusable_with.note: Distinguish a painted boundary, a shading boundary and geometric connectivity.
Distinguish a painted boundary, a shading boundary and geometric connectivity.
Distinguish a painted boundary, a shading boundary and geometric connectivity.

entries.label: proportion
entries.description: The size relation between parts, or between a part and the whole.

operationalization.guidance: Specify which ratio it is among width, height, length and area, together with the reference part.

entries.label: shape language

aliases.text: ภาษารูปทรง

entries.description: Rules that convey role, character or style through recurring shape traits.

operationalization.guidance: Translate it into concrete candidates of corner, curvature, silhouette and proportion, and evaluate the emotional effect separately.

entries.label: mass
entries.description: The sense of volume or visual bulk when an object is read as one large group.

operationalization.guidance: Keep this distinct from physical mass; adjust the size, position and proportion of the large volumes.

confusable_with.note: Sculptural mass, perceived weight and physical center of mass are different concepts.
Sculptural mass, perceived weight and physical center of mass are different concepts.

entries.label: primary form

aliases.text: รูปทรงหลัก

entries.description: The large form that governs overall identity and silhouette.

operationalization.guidance: Fix the target's large masses first, and keep detail changes from damaging them.

entries.label: secondary form
entries.description: A mid-scale form attached to the primary that makes function and articulation read.

operationalization.guidance: Adjust size, junction and negative space relative to the primary mass.

entries.label: tertiary detail

aliases.text: ターシャリディテール
รายละเอียดลำดับสาม

entries.description: The detail layer below the large forms, such as panel lines and small relief.

operationalization.guidance: Keep only the detail actually visible at the intended display size, and check for contour intrusion.

entries.label: shape hierarchy

aliases.text: ลำดับชั้นของรูปทรง

entries.description: The roles and priority held by large, medium and small forms.

operationalization.guidance: Specify the asset parts and the manipulation scope of each tier separately.

entries.label: plane
entries.description: A surface region whose facing stays relatively constant when the form is simplified.

operationalization.guidance: Adjust the plane's orientation and the transition to adjacent planes.

entries.label: planar break

aliases.text: จุดหักของระนาบ

entries.description: The place where plane direction changes and articulates the form.

operationalization.guidance: Adjust the orientation and boundary position of that plane pair, and confirm under lighting.

entries.label: planar transition

aliases.text: การเปลี่ยนผ่านระนาบ

entries.description: The form change that carries one plane or mass into another.

operationalization.guidance: Specify whether the transition is sharp or a soft blend, and inspect mesh and normal results separately.

entries.label: primitive decomposition

aliases.text: การแตกเป็นรูปทรงพื้นฐาน

entries.description: Breaking a complex subject into simple boxes, cylinders and wedges.

operationalization.guidance: Specify per part the primitive, its relative size and its placement.

entries.label: primitive massing

aliases.text: プリミティブによるマッス出し
การวางมวลด้วยรูปทรงพื้นฐาน

entries.description: The stage that builds overall volume and proportion from primitives, without detail.

operationalization.guidance: Defer material and fine detail, and verify silhouette and size relations.

entries.label: blockout

aliases.text: บล็อกเอาต์

entries.description: A draft that builds space or objects from simple shapes instead of final assets.

operationalization.guidance: Specify the camera, size and placement range to be verified.

entries.label: box
entries.description: A box-like mass built from straight planes.

operationalization.guidance: Specify per-axis size, position and rotation.

entries.label: sphere
entries.description: The spherical primitive used to test curved form, lighting and material.

operationalization.guidance: State whether radius or diameter is meant, and the unit.

entries.label: cylinder
entries.description: A primitive whose circular cross-section runs along its length.

operationalization.guidance: Specify radius, length and axis direction.

entries.label: wedge
entries.description: A mass that creates directionality and changing thickness through slanted planes.

operationalization.guidance: Specify the reference cross-section, height and slope direction.

entries.label: rounded capsule
entries.description: An elongated body with rounded ends, as used in the drone example.

operationalization.guidance: Specify the major-to-minor ratio and the shape of the end caps. It does not always mean a particular engine primitive.

entries.label: trapezoid

aliases.text: สี่เหลี่ยมคางหมู

entries.description: A flat shape with parallel sides of different length.

operationalization.guidance: Set edge lengths, height and orientation, and state which edge faces front.

entries.label: ellipse
entries.description: The ellipse used for a projected circular section or for flat design.

operationalization.guidance: State the major axis, minor axis and rotation.

entries.label: circle
entries.description: A circular element on the plane.

operationalization.guidance: Specify radius and center, and keep emissiveness as a separate property.

entries.label: triangle

aliases.text: สามเหลี่ยม

entries.description: A flat shape that reads through three sides.

operationalization.guidance: Adjust vertices and orientation. Distinguish this from render mesh triangle count.

entries.label: rectangle

aliases.text: สี่เหลี่ยมผืนผ้า

entries.description: The rectangular shape used for layout and massing in the discussion.

operationalization.guidance: Specify width, height and rotation.

entries.label: negative-space notch

aliases.text: ร่องเว้าพื้นที่ลบ

entries.description: A cut-in gap that separates the silhouette between neighboring masses.

operationalization.guidance: Specify the minimum gap width at the inspection camera and resolution.

entries.label: internal panel line

aliases.text: เส้นแบ่งแผง

entries.description: An interior line that articulates the surface without changing the outline.

operationalization.guidance: Set line position, width and contrast, and preserve the outer silhouette.

entries.label: contour economy

aliases.text: ความประหยัดของเส้นขอบ

entries.description: The property of conveying the needed features with few boundary changes.

operationalization.guidance: Reduce curve points and small undulations, but compare the reading outcome.

entries.label: modular construction

aliases.text: การประกอบแบบโมดูล

entries.description: Building assets by combining reusable parts.

operationalization.guidance: Specify module boundaries, junction conditions, and which parts are shared versus varied.

entries.label: anatomy
entries.description: Structural knowledge of the human form and what supports its movement.

operationalization.guidance: Limit it to what the silhouette, joint and proportion purpose requires; do not expand anatomical detail into the extract at will.

entries.label: ribcage
entries.description: The mass that stands for the upper torso in simplified figure construction.

operationalization.guidance: Specify its position and tilt relative to the pelvis.

entries.label: pelvis
entries.description: The mass that stands for the lower torso in simplified figure construction.

operationalization.guidance: Build the pose from its positional relation to the ribcage and legs.

entries.label: mannequin
entries.description: A pose statement that adds basic volume to a stick figure.

operationalization.guidance: Fit joint positions, large volumes and the pose silhouette first.

entries.label: position
entries.description: Where a subject sits in the chosen coordinate system.

operationalization.guidance: State the axis, origin, unit, parent transform and the basis of application.

entries.label: rotation
entries.description: A change in the orientation of a subject or reference axis.

operationalization.guidance: State the axis, coordinate system, rotation order, degrees or radians, and the reference state.

entries.label: scale
entries.description: The transform that changes a subject's size per axis by multiplication.

operationalization.guidance: State the factor and the reference state. Do not confuse a width increase rate with an area increase rate.

confusable_with.note: A 20% length increase is not the same as a 20% area increase.

entries.label: transform

aliases.text: ทรานส์ฟอร์ม

entries.description: The bundled statement of position, rotation, scale and other spatial transforms.

operationalization.guidance: Fix the space of each component and the order of application.

entries.label: affine

aliases.text: การแปลงแอฟฟีน

entries.description: A linear transform combined with translation that preserves parallel relations.

operationalization.guidance: Specify the matrix's coordinate system, multiplication order and vector convention.

entries.label: projection
entries.description: The transform that maps 3D positions to positions in the camera image.

operationalization.guidance: Specify the projection type, camera, aspect ratio and clip conventions.

entries.label: object space

aliases.text: สเปซของออบเจกต์

entries.description: The space that states position by the subject's own axes and origin.

operationalization.guidance: State which object serves as the reference.

entries.label: world space

aliases.text: เวิลด์สเปซ

entries.description: The space that states position and orientation by the scene's shared reference.

operationalization.guidance: Fix the world origin, axes and unit conversion.

entries.label: view space
entries.description: The space that states position and orientation relative to the camera.

operationalization.guidance: State the camera selector and the axis convention.

entries.label: clip space
entries.description: The homogeneous coordinate space used for projection and clipping.

operationalization.guidance: Do not treat it directly as screen pixel coordinates; state the projection, divide and API conventions.

entries.label: screen space
entries.description: The space that states a subject by position in the output image.

operationalization.guidance: Specify internal render versus final output, the origin, the axis direction, and pixel or normalized coordinates.

entries.label: depth
entries.description: Front-to-back placement, or depth relative to the camera.

operationalization.guidance: Specify which is meant among camera distance, view-space depth and depth-buffer value.

confusable_with.note: Distinguish distance in space from an encoded buffer value.

entries.label: depth cue

aliases.text: สัญญาณบอกความลึก

entries.description: A visual cue such as overlap, perspective or lighting that makes depth read.

operationalization.guidance: Manipulate the chosen cue and test by the reading of spatial order.

entries.label: foreshortening

aliases.text: การย่นระยะ

entries.description: The effect where part of an object projects shorter depending on viewing direction.

operationalization.guidance: Confirm the camera and axis direction before changing object proportions.

entries.label: perspective grid

aliases.text: กริดเพอร์สเปกทีฟ

entries.description: A guide line structure for keeping perspective relations consistent.

operationalization.guidance: Use it tied to a camera or a vanishing relation.

entries.label: axis
entries.description: The reference direction by which transforms and orientation are read.

operationalization.guidance: Do not infer the axis conversion between engine and DCC; confirm it in the adapter.

entries.label: origin
entries.description: The point that anchors an object's position and transforms.

operationalization.guidance: Distinguish moving the mesh itself from moving the origin.

confusable_with.note: Do not assume the data origin and the current operation pivot are the same point.

entries.label: pivot
entries.description: The reference point for rotation, scale and placement.

operationalization.guidance: State whether it is sprite normalized coordinates or world coordinates, and the pivot actually being manipulated.

confusable_with.note: Do not assume the data origin and the current operation pivot are the same point.

entries.label: parent/child transform

aliases.text: 親子のトランスフォーム
ทรานส์ฟอร์มแม่-ลูก

entries.description: The relation in which a child's transform follows its parent's.

operationalization.guidance: Distinguish the local value from the final world result, and specify the hierarchy.

entries.label: size
entries.description: The umbrella statement for a subject's length, width, height or screen size.

operationalization.guidance: Make the axis, bounds, dimension and unit of the size concrete.

entries.label: direction
entries.description: The direction a subject faces, extends or travels.

operationalization.guidance: Specify which is meant among object orientation, light direction and screen movement direction.

entries.label: camera
entries.description: The component that decides from what viewpoint and projection a scene is observed.

operationalization.guidance: Record the selector, projection, transform and output conditions together.

entries.label: camera position

aliases.text: ตำแหน่งกล้อง

entries.description: Where the camera sits in the scene.

operationalization.guidance: Distinguish it from a change that moves the object, and specify world or parent space.

entries.label: camera angle
entries.description: The camera's orientation and viewpoint onto the subject.

operationalization.guidance: Specify the rotation axis and the reference or the target to look at.

entries.label: camera distance
entries.description: The distance between the camera and a named subject or reference point.

operationalization.guidance: Fix the point the distance is measured to. Distinguish an FOV change from a dolly move.

confusable_with.note: FOV, dolly movement and orthographic extent are not the same manipulation.
FOV, dolly movement and orthographic extent are not the same manipulation.

entries.label: FOV
entries.description: The angular range the camera takes in.

operationalization.guidance: State the axis among vertical, horizontal and diagonal, the projection type, and the aspect ratio.

confusable_with.note: FOV, dolly movement and orthographic extent are not the same manipulation.
FOV, dolly movement and orthographic extent are not the same manipulation.

entries.label: perspective

aliases.text: เพอร์สเปกทีฟ

entries.description: The camera mode in which projected size changes with distance.

operationalization.guidance: Manage camera position, orientation, FOV and output aspect ratio together.

entries.label: orthographic

aliases.text: ออร์โทกราฟิก

entries.description: Parallel projection with no size falloff from depth.

operationalization.guidance: Specify the projection extent and the screen size. Do not assume it is adjusted with an FOV slider.

confusable_with.note: FOV, dolly movement and orthographic extent are not the same manipulation.
FOV, dolly movement and orthographic extent are not the same manipulation.

entries.label: frustum
entries.description: The view volume the camera uses for clipping and visibility decisions.

operationalization.guidance: Preserve the source spelling frustrum as a candidate typo and keep frustum as the canonical search term.

entries.label: near/far depth

aliases.text: ระนาบใกล้และไกล

entries.description: The distance range the camera handles in front of and behind.

operationalization.guidance: First decide whether it is a clip plane distance or plain placement depth.

entries.label: shot size
entries.description: The shot classification by how much of the subject the frame shows.

operationalization.guidance: State the target occupancy, the parts that get cropped, and the camera together.

entries.label: wide
entries.description: A framing that takes in the space and relations around the subject.

operationalization.guidance: Do not give only the name; specify the targets that must be included and the margin.

entries.label: close
entries.description: A framing that shows the subject or a part of it large.

operationalization.guidance: Specify the parts to include in frame and the screen occupancy.

entries.label: low angle
entries.description: A framing that views the subject from a relatively low viewpoint.

operationalization.guidance: Specify the reference target and the camera height and upward angle.

entries.label: front

aliases.text: มุมด้านหน้า

entries.description: The inspection viewpoint taken on the subject's front.

operationalization.guidance: Fix what counts as the model's front by axis or landmark.

entries.label: side

aliases.text: มุมด้านข้าง

entries.description: The inspection viewpoint taken on the subject's side.

operationalization.guidance: State left or right, and the model axis.

entries.label: 3/4 view

aliases.text: มุมสามส่วนสี่

entries.description: The oblique viewpoint that shows front and side together.

operationalization.guidance: Do not settle the angle from the conventional name alone; specify the actual camera transform.

entries.label: value

aliases.text: ค่าน้ำหนักแสงเงา

entries.description: The artistic axis that organizes light and dark relations.

operationalization.guidance: Do not automatically treat it as identical to HSV V, linear luminance or display brightness.

confusable_with.note: Artistic value, a color-model value and a material input are never substituted for one another.
Artistic value, a color-model value and a material input are never substituted for one another.

entries.label: tone
entries.description: In this discussion, mostly the light-and-dark structure of the frame.

operationalization.guidance: Distinguish tone in this context from the tone mapping operation.

confusable_with.note: Distinguish artistic value from an output-side operation.

entries.label: value grouping

aliases.text: การจัดกลุ่มค่าน้ำหนัก

entries.description: Organizing the frame by binding detail into large value groups.

operationalization.guidance: Specify the region masks and the restricted set of values.

entries.label: 3-value study

aliases.text: แบบฝึกสามค่าน้ำหนัก

entries.description: A study that simplifies the frame into three values such as black, gray and white.

operationalization.guidance: Set three palette values and the target regions. Distinguish automatic threshold segmentation from hand-designed value design.

entries.label: grayscale
entries.description: A statement that drops hue difference and shows the light-dark component.

operationalization.guidance: Fix the conversion formula, color space and output transform, and use it as an auxiliary readability check.

entries.label: value contrast

aliases.text: คอนทราสต์ค่าน้ำหนัก

entries.description: The light-dark difference between subjects.

operationalization.guidance: Decide which regions are compared and on which brightness scale.

entries.label: tone affinity

aliases.text: ความคล้ายของโทน

entries.description: The state where the value relations of subjects or screen regions bind together.

operationalization.guidance: Specify the regions to compare and the value scale.

entries.label: contrast hierarchy

aliases.text: コントラストの優先順位
ลำดับชั้นของคอนทราสต์

entries.description: The structure that decides which of several contrasts in the frame takes priority.

operationalization.guidance: Manage the contrast around the object of attention separately from background contrast.

entries.label: highlight
entries.description: A bright accent region produced by light response or by stylistic statement.

operationalization.guidance: Distinguish a surface reflection from a hand-placed accent, and adjust position, width and value.

entries.label: shadow
entries.description: A region that receives less light or is bound dark as a matter of statement.

operationalization.guidance: Distinguish form shadow, cast shadow and painted-in shading.

entries.label: lighting
entries.description: The setup that builds form and screen mood from light sources and environment.

operationalization.guidance: Separate the scope of change across light, environment, exposure and material.

entries.label: light
entries.description: The light, or engine light source, contributing to how objects and space are lit.

operationalization.guidance: Specify the light type, direction, intensity and color, and the renderer.

confusable_with.note: Distinguish a material signal, image post-processing, and lighting another target.
Distinguish a material signal, image post-processing, and lighting another target.

entries.label: light direction

aliases.text: ライトディレクション

entries.description: The direction light travels or faces the surface from.

operationalization.guidance: Confirm the sign convention between the incident direction and the vector pointing toward the light.

entries.label: intensity

aliases.text: ความเข้มแสง

entries.description: The value that controls a light source's output strength.

operationalization.guidance: State the engine, light type and unit model. Do not read an arbitrary unit directly as a physical unit.

entries.label: directional light

aliases.text: ディレクショナルライト

entries.description: The engine light type whose main property is direction.

operationalization.guidance: Adjust rotation, color and intensity separately from the shadow settings.

entries.label: form shadow
entries.description: The dark part of the object itself where surface facing takes less direct light.

operationalization.guidance: Compare the light direction against the surface orientation, and keep it separate from cast shadow.

entries.label: cast shadow

aliases.text: เงาตกกระทบ

entries.description: The shadow made on another surface where the object blocks the light.

operationalization.guidance: Specify the occluding object, the receiving surface and the light relation.

entries.label: terminator

aliases.text: เส้นแบ่งแสงเงา

entries.description: The boundary on a form between the lit side and the unlit side.

operationalization.guidance: Consider the normal, the light and the stylized shading basis together.

entries.label: ambient

aliases.text: แสงแวดล้อม

entries.description: The term for ambient light contribution beyond individual direct sources.

operationalization.guidance: State the actual implementation, such as the engine environment lighting or a constant term.

entries.label: bounce

aliases.text: แสงสะท้อนต่อ

entries.description: The indirect light contribution that arrives after reflecting off another surface.

operationalization.guidance: Specify whether it is actually computed or an art-side fill light, and its color, intensity and region.

entries.label: backlight
entries.description: A lighting placement coming from behind the subject relative to the camera.

operationalization.guidance: Set the light direction relative to the camera and the target, and confirm the rim reading.

entries.label: Lambert
entries.description: The simple diffuse response model using the relation of surface and incident direction.

operationalization.guidance: Put the normal and light vectors in the same space, and keep color and intensity factors distinct.

entries.label: N·L
entries.description: The value stating surface facing as the dot product of normal and light direction.

operationalization.guidance: State normalization, space, sign, and how negative values are handled.

entries.label: fake lighting

aliases.text: フェイクライティング

entries.description: Lighting added for readability and intent rather than physical consistency.

operationalization.guidance: State the form cues to preserve and the brightness, color and regions to change.

entries.label: secondary lighting

aliases.text: セカンダリライティング
การจัดแสงชั้นรอง

entries.description: The project stage adding extra tint or light response onto pixelated subjects.

operationalization.guidance: State the source of the geometric information and the ordering around pixelation, dithering and upscaling. Do not assert it is a second bounce of global illumination.

entries.label: radiometry

aliases.text: เรดิโอเมตรี

entries.description: The base concept treating the transfer of light energy quantitatively.

operationalization.guidance: It is mentioned in the source only as a reference field, so do not expand it into a specific system of physical quantities at will.

entries.label: light transport

aliases.text: ライトトランスポート
การส่งผ่านแสง

entries.description: The process by which light is carried between sources, surfaces and media.

operationalization.guidance: Distinguish the rendering approximation in use from art-side changes.

entries.label: color
entries.description: The color component and perceptual relations of surfaces, lights and images.

operationalization.guidance: When using numbers, specify the model, color space, transfer function and range.

confusable_with.note: Artistic value, a color-model value and a material input are never substituted for one another.
Artistic value, a color-model value and a material input are never substituted for one another.

entries.label: hue
entries.description: The axis of a color model separating color as red, yellow, green and so on.

operationalization.guidance: State the model, such as HSV, and the angular range, and treat it as a cyclic value.

entries.label: saturation

aliases.text: ความอิ่มตัวของสี

entries.description: The axis controlling a color's distance from neutral in the chosen model or tool.

operationalization.guidance: State the model, the point of operation and the range. Do not assume the same number gives the same result across tools.

entries.label: warm/cool relation

aliases.text: ความสัมพันธ์สีอุ่นสีเย็น

entries.description: The relation in which colors read as relatively warm or cool.

operationalization.guidance: State which color serves as the basis of comparison. It is not a property that must be expressed as a Kelvin value.

confusable_with.note: Distinguish light Kelvin, relational warm/cool, and a tool color-correction control.
Distinguish light Kelvin, relational warm/cool, and a tool color-correction control.

entries.label: simultaneous contrast

aliases.text: คอนทราสต์พร้อมกัน

entries.description: The effect where the same color reads differently because of surrounding color or value.

operationalization.guidance: Hold the center color fixed and compare by changing the surrounding region.

entries.label: palette
entries.description: The set of colors used across a picture or an asset set.

operationalization.guidance: State the color list, the roles, and the permitted ranges.

entries.label: palette hierarchy

aliases.text: ลำดับชั้นของชุดสี

entries.description: The priority in a color set between dominant, secondary and accent colors.

operationalization.guidance: Separate each color's role from its area of use and its contrast target.

entries.label: palette discipline

aliases.text: วินัยของชุดสี

entries.description: The rule that keeps permitted color relations and color count consistent.

operationalization.guidance: Specify the permitted colors, the exceptions, and the gradient policy.

entries.label: local color

aliases.text: สีประจำวัตถุ

entries.description: The subject's own color, stated apart from lighting effects.

operationalization.guidance: Keep the material base color distinct from the final pixel color.

entries.label: light color
entries.description: The color composition of the light.

operationalization.guidance: Distinguish a light parameter from a compositing tint.

entries.label: surrounding color
entries.description: Color placed around a subject that influences how it is perceived.

operationalization.guidance: Specify which surrounding region, together with its mask.

entries.label: perceived color

aliases.text: สีที่รับรู้

entries.description: The color a person reads in the final context and viewing condition.

operationalization.guidance: Do not equate it with RGB values; set the conditions of comparison.

entries.label: color temperature

aliases.text: อุณหภูมิสี

entries.description: The term treating light color or white balance along a warm-cool direction.

operationalization.guidance: State whether it is physical Kelvin or the tool's Temperature correction slider.

confusable_with.note: Distinguish light Kelvin, relational warm/cool, and a tool color-correction control.
Distinguish light Kelvin, relational warm/cool, and a tool color-correction control.

entries.label: tint
entries.description: The manipulation that leans a color in a direction or applies a color filter.

operationalization.guidance: Specify the actual operation among multiply color, additive offset and white-balance correction.

confusable_with.note: Distinguish light Kelvin, relational warm/cool, and a tool color-correction control.
Distinguish light Kelvin, relational warm/cool, and a tool color-correction control.

entries.label: vibrance
entries.description: A tool-specific control that corrects color intensity selectively.

operationalization.guidance: Do not substitute it with the same operation as saturation; confirm the implementation and range.

entries.label: gamma curve

aliases.text: เส้นโค้งแกมมา

entries.description: The term for a nonlinear value transfer curve or a tool's gamma control.

operationalization.guidance: Distinguish the project color space, the transfer function, and a creative correction.

entries.label: exposure
entries.description: The value adjusting image or lighting brightness in exposure terms.

operationalization.guidance: State the tool convention, whether a linear factor or stops/EV.

entries.label: sRGB
entries.description: The RGB color encoding system that comes up when handling texture and display color.

operationalization.guidance: Distinguish input and output transforms so encoded RGB is not operated on as if it were linear-light values.

entries.label: linear color

aliases.text: สีเชิงเส้น

entries.description: A statement that handles color math in values proportional to light quantity.

operationalization.guidance: State which RGB primaries the linear values belong to. Linear is not a complete color space name.

confusable_with.note: Linear-light color and interpolation over time are unrelated.

entries.label: LUT

aliases.text: ルックアップテーブル
ตารางเทียบสี

entries.description: A precomputed table mapping input colors to output colors.

operationalization.guidance: Specify the input and output color spaces, the application order, and the asset.

entries.label: color grading

aliases.text: カラーグレーディング

entries.description: Changing the final screen's color and value relations to match intent.

operationalization.guidance: Record the changes to exposure, contrast and hue, and the compositing order.

entries.label: tone mapping
entries.description: The stage mapping a wide signal range onto a displayable statement.

operationalization.guidance: State the input range, output transform and algorithm, and distinguish it from artistic tone itself.

confusable_with.note: Distinguish artistic value from an output-side operation.

entries.label: color contrast

aliases.text: คอนทราสต์ของสี

entries.description: The relation in which two regions read as different in color.

operationalization.guidance: Specify the comparison axis among hue, saturation and lightness, or the color-difference formula.

entries.label: color affinity

aliases.text: ความคล้ายของสี

entries.description: The relation in which elements' colors bind together and read alike.

operationalization.guidance: Specify the color set and the comparison model.

entries.label: complementary scheme

aliases.text: ชุดสีตรงข้าม

entries.description: A color arrangement using opposite relations on the color wheel.

operationalization.guidance: State which color wheel or model the relation belongs to.

entries.label: surface
entries.description: The boundary at which form responds to light and texture, or its statement.

operationalization.guidance: Separate the scope of change across geometry, material, normals and texture.

confusable_with.note: Distinguish the local sense of an operation layer from the surface of an object.

entries.label: material
entries.description: The bundle of surface response and its related textures and parameters.

operationalization.guidance: State the shader model, the workflow, the objects sharing it, and the asset.

entries.label: surface response

aliases.text: การตอบสนองของพื้นผิว

entries.description: How a surface responds to changes of light and viewpoint.

operationalization.guidance: Compare the effect of material and normals under identical lighting and camera conditions.

entries.label: material cue

aliases.text: สัญญาณบอกวัสดุ

entries.description: The highlight, color or surface pattern cue that makes something read as metal, rubber and so on.

operationalization.guidance: Choose concrete cues to manipulate, and evaluate the material reading outcome separately.

entries.label: PBR

aliases.text: 物理ベースレンダリング

entries.description: The material and shading approach using principles of physical surface response.

operationalization.guidance: Specify the engine model and input workflow in use. It does not denote a single kind of look.

entries.label: BRDF
entries.description: The function stating surface reflection by incoming and outgoing direction.

operationalization.guidance: State which model and parameters are used.

entries.label: BSDF
entries.description: The function category stating surface scattering response including reflection and transmission.

operationalization.guidance: Distinguish its scope from BRDF and bind it to an actual node or model.

entries.label: base color / albedo
entries.description: The value used as the base color input to lighting in a material workflow.

operationalization.guidance: Record that the meaning differs for metal and non-metal depending on the workflow. Do not assume it is synonymous with albedo in every context.

confusable_with.note: Artistic value, a color-model value and a material input are never substituted for one another.
Artistic value, a color-model value and a material input are never substituted for one another.

entries.label: metallic

aliases.text: ความเป็นโลหะ

entries.description: The surface-character input of a metal / non-metal workflow.

operationalization.guidance: Confirm the actual shader model and channel, and do not confuse it with specular intensity.

entries.label: roughness

entries.description: The value or system classifying processing order of render targets.

operationalization.guidance: Confirm the engine, pipeline, sorting and depth conditions. Do not equate it with sorting layer.

entries.label: depth

aliases.text: เดปท์บัฟเฟอร์

entries.description: The stored depth value statement used for visibility and effects.

operationalization.guidance: State whether it is linear distance or a projected value, plus the range and API convention.

confusable_with.note: Distinguish distance in space from an encoded buffer value.

entries.label: stencil
entries.description: The statement limiting render area by per-pixel integer marks and tests.

operationalization.guidance: State the read/write masks, the comparison, the operation, and who else shares it.

entries.label: transparency

aliases.text: ความโปร่งใส

entries.description: The way of stating a surface together with the background or elements behind it.

operationalization.guidance: Confirm the opaque/clip/blend model, depth writing, and ordering.

entries.label: blending
entries.description: The operation combining a new value with the existing buffer value by a stated rule.

operationalization.guidance: State the source, destination, alpha, and color space.

entries.label: alpha clip
entries.description: Treatment keeping or discarding pixels by a threshold such as alpha.

operationalization.guidance: Specify the channel used, the threshold, the depth, and the anti-aliasing policy.

entries.label: alpha blend

aliases.text: อัลฟาเบลนด์

entries.description: Treatment compositing front and back colors using alpha.

operationalization.guidance: Confirm the input convention, such as straight or premultiplied, and the blend equation.

entries.label: premultiplied alpha

aliases.text: プリマルチプライドアルファ
อัลฟาคูณล่วงหน้า

entries.description: The storage and compositing convention where alpha is already multiplied into the color components.

operationalization.guidance: Match the input asset to the shader and blend settings, and avoid double multiplication.

entries.label: camera stacking

aliases.text: การซ้อนกล้อง

entries.description: The engine feature composing several camera outputs into one result.

operationalization.guidance: Confirm the camera order, clear, depth and resolution, and the supported renderer.

entries.label: Renderer Feature

aliases.text: レンダラーフィーチャー

entries.description: The setup integrating custom render behavior into the URP renderer.

operationalization.guidance: Confirm the actual URP version, the target renderer, and the injection point.

entries.label: Fullscreen Pass
entries.description: The render work processing values over the whole screen.

operationalization.guidance: State the input texture, the shader, when it executes, and the resolution.

entries.label: injection point

aliases.text: インジェクションポイント

entries.description: The place in the render flow where custom operations are inserted.

operationalization.guidance: Confirm the pipeline's actual event name and the point at which the required inputs are available.

entries.label: Render Graph
entries.description: The setup describing render work and resource dependencies as a graph.

operationalization.guidance: State resource reads, writes and lifetimes. Do not infer the actual execution order from a diagram alone.

entries.label: Render Graph resources

aliases.text: レンダーグラフのリソース
ทรัพยากรของ Render Graph

entries.description: The declared textures and buffers passed between passes.

operationalization.guidance: Record the format, size, producer, consumer, and lifetime.

entries.label: 2D normal map

aliases.text: นอร์มัลแมปสองมิติ

entries.description: The map statement giving sprites a surface-facing cue.

operationalization.guidance: Confirm the sprite UVs, the normal convention, and 2D renderer support.

entries.label: URP

aliases.text: ユニバーサルレンダーパイプライン

entries.description: The render pipeline used as the Unity implementation base in the discussion.

operationalization.guidance: Confirm the project's actual version and its 2D/3D renderer configuration.

entries.label: HDRP
entries.description: The Unity render pipeline that came up as a comparison.

operationalization.guidance: Do not treat its settings and API as identical to URP.

entries.label: custom SRP

aliases.text: SRP ที่กำหนดเอง

entries.description: A scriptable render pipeline composed by the user.

operationalization.guidance: Take the project implementation itself as authoritative.

entries.label: CommandBuffer.Blit
entries.description: The image copy and processing API mentioned in contrast to the render pass explanation.

operationalization.guidance: Verify separately whether it is available in the current project and what the recommended path is. This vocabulary extract does not recommend the call.

entries.label: draw call
entries.description: The unit submitting render work as a draw command, or the aggregate metric of it.

operationalization.guidance: Specify the measurement tool, frame and camera scope. The count alone does not establish performance.

entries.label: batching

aliases.text: การรวมชุดวาด

entries.description: The method reducing submission or state cost by grouping several draw operations.

operationalization.guidance: Measure the actual batching type, the conditions that break it, and the CPU/GPU outcome.

entries.label: overdraw

aliases.text: โอเวอร์ดรอว์

entries.description: The view on render overlap cost from processing the same screen area repeatedly.

operationalization.guidance: Fix the counting definition, the opaque/transparent scope, and the measurement pass.

entries.label: shader complexity

aliases.text: ความซับซ้อนของเชดเดอร์

entries.description: A shader's cost characteristics in computation, memory access and branching.

operationalization.guidance: Do not equate graph node count with GPU time; measure on the target.

entries.label: texture budget

aliases.text: テクスチャバジェット
งบเท็กซ์เจอร์

entries.description: The range allowed for texture resolution, count and memory.

operationalization.guidance: State the actual format, mips and platform, and the unit of the budget.

entries.label: texture memory

aliases.text: หน่วยความจำเท็กซ์เจอร์

entries.description: The storage or GPU memory size a texture uses.

operationalization.guidance: State which is being measured among disk, CPU, GPU and resident size.

entries.label: memory budget

aliases.text: งบหน่วยความจำ

entries.description: The memory range allowed for assets, clips and render resources.

operationalization.guidance: Set the target resources and the point of aggregation, such as resident or peak.

entries.label: LOD

aliases.text: ระดับรายละเอียด

entries.description: The statement strategy changing an asset's detail amount by condition.

operationalization.guidance: Specify the distance or screen-size basis, the levels, the transitions, and silhouette preservation.

entries.label: CPU cost
entries.description: The cost that render, animation and asset processing take on the CPU.

operationalization.guidance: State the target, the profiler section, the frame distribution, and the bottleneck context.

entries.label: GPU cost
entries.description: The cost that render work and computation take on the GPU.

operationalization.guidance: Fix the target, resolution, passes, synchronization, and the measured section.

entries.label: platform budget

aliases.text: プラットフォームバジェット
งบของแพลตฟอร์ม

entries.description: The bundle of performance, memory and display conditions to hold on the target platform.

operationalization.guidance: State the device, the quality settings, the measurement scenario, and the criteria.

entries.label: visual regression

aliases.text: ビジュアルリグレッション
การถดถอยทางภาพ

entries.description: Checking whether screen characteristics that must be preserved were damaged by a change.

operationalization.guidance: Fix the reference image, camera, time, random conditions, and the tolerance.

entries.label: consistency

aliases.text: ความสม่ำเสมอ

entries.description: How far assets, motion and display rules stay in agreement with each other.

operationalization.guidance: Decide which rules are compared, and separate its evaluation scope from style coherence.

entries.label: asset portfolio integrity

aliases.text: ความครบถ้วนของชุดแอสเซต

entries.description: The condition of an asset set holding without omissions or style and spec mismatches.

operationalization.guidance: State the required assets, their roles, specifications, and reference relationships.

entries.label: atlas budget
entries.description: The range allowed for atlas count, resolution, memory and packing.

operationalization.guidance: Evaluate it together with the page count, platform format, and padding conditions.

entries.label: resolution standard

aliases.text: มาตรฐานความละเอียด

entries.description: The rule for source and runtime resolution to hold per asset type.

operationalization.guidance: Record the type, display size, PPU, and downscaling rule.

entries.label: material count

aliases.text: จำนวนวัสดุ

entries.description: The number of materials an asset or scene uses.

operationalization.guidance: Distinguish unique asset count, slot count, and runtime instance count.

entries.label: material slots

aliases.text: สล็อตวัสดุ

entries.description: The slot setup assigning materials to mesh parts.

operationalization.guidance: Inspect the slot count, indices, bound materials, and submesh relationships.

entries.label: retarget QA

aliases.text: การตรวจหลังรีทาร์เกต

entries.description: The check of whether pose, contact, proportion and motion meaning survive retargeting.

operationalization.guidance: Use the same inspection clip and joint references for source and target.

entries.label: regression QA

aliases.text: การตรวจการถดถอย

entries.description: Checking whether a change damaged existing asset function and statement.

operationalization.guidance: Fix the reference result, the inspection items, and the reproduction conditions.

entries.label: object statistics

aliases.text: สถิติของออบเจกต์

entries.description: The report confirming counts of mesh, material and asset structure.

operationalization.guidance: State what is actually being counted, such as the evaluated mesh or the export result.

asset de origem ≠ representação em execução

operationalization.guidance: Include stable target IDs, units and conditions. Do not treat it as a directly executable tool command.

entries.label: generation script

aliases.text: สคริปต์สร้างงาน

entries.description: The code artifact producing an asset or scene from a specification.

operationalization.guidance: Specify the execution environment, inputs, outputs, reproducibility conditions, and permitted write paths.

entries.label: headless render

aliases.text: การเรนเดอร์แบบไม่มีหน้าจอ

entries.description: The run mode producing render output without an interactive UI.

operationalization.guidance: Confirm the actual render backend, output, GPU requirements, and failure states in the execution environment.

entries.label: render validation

aliases.text: การตรวจด้วยการเรนเดอร์

entries.description: The stage confirming the generated result on an actual screen.

operationalization.guidance: Fix the camera, time, resolution, color handling, and the criteria for judgment.

entries.label: vision critique

aliases.text: การวิจารณ์ทางภาพ

entries.description: The work of observing a rendered image and judging its gap from the visual intent.

operationalization.guidance: State the evaluation axes, the original, and the comparison image, and separate subjective assessment from numeric fact.

entries.label: turntable

aliases.text: เทิร์นเทเบิล

entries.description: The rotating inspection video for checking an object from several directions.

operationalization.guidance: Specify whether the object or the camera rotates, plus the angles and the lighting.

entries.label: export

aliases.text: การเอ็กซ์พอร์ต

entries.description: Converting an editing source into a delivery or runtime format.

operationalization.guidance: State the format, units, axes, included assets, and the scope of modification.

entries.label: FBX
entries.description: The file kind mentioned as a delivery format for models and animation.

operationalization.guidance: Confirm the actual exporter/importer version and the data it supports.

entries.label: glTF
entries.description: The file kind mentioned as a delivery format for models and materials.

operationalization.guidance: Confirm feature support, axes, units, and texture paths on the actual path.

entries.label: .blend
entries.description: The editable Blender scene and asset source.

operationalization.guidance: Record the version, externally dependent assets, and the generating script together.

entries.label: naming

aliases.text: การตั้งชื่อ

entries.description: The rule identifying assets, nodes and parts consistently.

operationalization.guidance: Distinguish a stable ID from a human-readable name.

entries.label: versioning

aliases.text: การจัดการเวอร์ชัน

entries.description: The system distinguishing change states of assets and specifications.

operationalization.guidance: Record the reference revision and the correspondence between source and output.

entries.label: variant management

aliases.text: การจัดการวาเรียนต์

entries.description: The method managing a base asset and its color, damage and shape variants consistently.

operationalization.guidance: State the shared parts, the differences, and the derivation relationships.

entries.label: reuse
entries.description: The method using existing assets, clips, shapes and rules in another production.

operationalization.guidance: Decide whether to share by reference or to duplicate, and the scope of edit propagation.

entries.label: clip library
entries.description: The set of reusable animation clips.

operationalization.guidance: Record each clip's role, length, rig, and compatibility conditions.

entries.label: export automation

aliases.text: エクスポートの自動化
การเอ็กซ์พอร์ตอัตโนมัติ

entries.description: The work converting sources into runtime assets repeatedly to a spec.

operationalization.guidance: Specify the inputs, outputs, permissions, validation, and failure-handling rules.

entries.label: damage variant

aliases.text: วาเรียนต์ความเสียหาย

entries.description: The variant stating a damaged condition on a base asset.

operationalization.guidance: Decide the scope of change across silhouette, surface and color, and what it shares with the base asset.

entries.label: color variant

aliases.text: วาเรียนต์สี

entries.description: The asset keeping the base form and changing the color composition.

operationalization.guidance: Specify the color roles, the forbidden colors, and the conditions for preserving the value hierarchy.

entries.label: silhouette variant

aliases.text: シルエットバリアント
วาเรียนต์ซิลูเอตต์

entries.description: The variant differing in the outer shape of a base asset.

operationalization.guidance: Specify the masses to change and the identity features to preserve.

entries.label: UI icon variant

aliases.text: วาเรียนต์ไอคอน UI

entries.description: The asset converting an original object for small UI display.

operationalization.guidance: Set the target resolution, the simplification, and the readability criteria.

entries.label: feedback
entries.description: The work of recording and correcting the gaps among source, drawing and engine result.

operationalization.guidance: Separate judgment from observed values, and decide the single next change.

entries.scope_note: Separating judgment from observed values and choosing the single next change is the review loop itself.

entries.label: screenshot audit

aliases.text: スクリーンショット監査
การตรวจภาพหน้าจอ

entries.description: The inspection marking problems in a finished frame axis by axis.

operationalization.guidance: Fix the frames under review and the inspection axes, such as hierarchy, contrast, material and effects.

entries.scope_note: Not a practice exercise: auditing a finished frame axis by axis is the production review this vocabulary exists to support.

entries.label: markup

aliases.text: การทำมาร์กอัป

entries.description: The result marking problem areas and correction intent over the source.

operationalization.guidance: Track the original coordinates, arrows, masks and text separately.

entries.scope_note: Marking problem areas and correction intent over the source is how a direction is actually delivered, not how one is learned.

entries.label: operational surface

aliases.text: พื้นผิวที่ปรับได้

entries.description: In this discussion, the working sense of the layer of targets, properties and operations that can carry visual intent into actual manipulation.

operationalization.guidance: No formal standard definition has been supplied. The reading here is an editorial proposal, and is distinct from material surface.

confusable_with.note: Distinguish the local sense of an operation layer from the surface of an object.

entries.scope_note: Not a learning term, so it is kept, but its v1 definition reads 'in this discussion' — it names a concept this corpus coined rather than anything in a team's assets. Re-word or drop once a team has its own name for the layer.

entries.label: manipulative vocab

aliases.text: คำศัพท์สำหรับการปรับแต่ง

operationalization.guidance: Do not declare it a standard API or a single academic term.

entries.scope_note: Not a learning term, so it is kept, but its v1 definition reads 'in this request' — it names this vocabulary set itself, not a property of any artwork.

entries.label: shape contrast

aliases.text: คอนทราสต์ของรูปทรง

entries.description: The relation where subjects separate because their outline and mass traits differ.

operationalization.guidance: Fix which two shapes are compared, plus the camera and display size.

entries.label: edge
entries.description: The boundary that reads as a form division or a surface articulation.

operationalization.guidance: State which is being changed among a perceptual boundary, a drawn line and a geometric edge.

confusable_with.note: Distinguish a painted boundary, a shading boundary and geometric connectivity.

aliases.text: ปีกลู่หลัง

operationalization.guidance: Fix the reference body axis and plane, and state the sweep angle.

known_limits: Term selection removes the learning layer and keeps everything else. That is not evidence that what remains is an industry-standard set; it is the v1 corpus minus its practice exercises.
Descriptions and guidance are editorial. They are not verified against any external primary source.
quantification profiles state what must be fixed before a number means anything. They do not supply recommended values; no threshold here is a norm.
Perceptual goals are not numeric properties. A proxy metric measures a proxy, never the whole goal.
provenance.term_basis refers to the v1 corpus, whose sources are Korean interview and study conversations in an education context. Treat it as attestation of use, not industry endorsement.
